sections.heading: Emergency situations — B
sections.markdown:
Audience and scope: emergency situations within the selected first-time passenger-car knowledge preparation path. This is an authoring scope from the pinned run configuration.
Coverage plan: Avoiding an immediate crash; Vehicle malfunctions; Engine failure and breakdowns; Crash scene and reporting. These are authored organizational labels, with no official examination weighting or eligibility assertion.
Every extracted crash-avoidance, malfunction, breakdown, scene-information and report condition is represented. Braking and injured-person instructions remain source-qualified, not a complete vehicle-system or medical protocol. The brake-failure engine-off fallback and blanket stay-in-vehicle wording require applicability review. No current source or legal clearance is claimed.
